title: Ship /how: the link-only Frequency overview brief, with anonymous engagement tracking and a share card

source.ref: Requested by Daniel, 2026-11-16 (Frequency Overview design canvas thread).

detail:
WHAT: frequencylocal.com/how, a long-scroll brief for coaches and advisors explaining how Frequency works and where the money comes from. Link-only: page-level robots noindex (not robots.txt, so the noindex is read), outside (marketing) in app/(brief), not in the sitemap or site nav. The markup and CSS are generated from the Frequency Overview design canvas; calculators, side index rail and the scroll-aware 'Groups fade' loop run client-side. Tracking: 11 how.* events (view, section view and dwell, scroll depth, engaged-time heartbeat, calculator input, appendix, link clicks, copy, complete, exit) batched to app/api/how/beacon, which honours Sec-GPC and analytics consent, rate-limits per visit, and writes through track() with no profile. A ?r=<code> on the link tags every event so each reader is attributable. Spec and SQL: docs/HOW-BRIEF.md.

OWNER ACTION: add public/how-assets/programs/hof-mark-light.png (the Hearts on Fire mark); until then that slot shows a flame placeholder.

verify.note: Fails if /how becomes indexable or listed, renders a raw template hole, loses its beacon, or sends an unregistered event.
